chapter: Henderson, Lester and the bands breaking up
title: Ethel Mays's band in Little Rock
summary: Tate is in Little Rock with Ethel Mays's women's band when Basie brings the Moten band.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: So Smack -- we called Fletcher "Smack" -- Smack chose Lester over Ben or Herschel and so when Basie, maybe about a couple of weeks later, Basie brings the Bennie Moten band to Little Rock. So I was in Little Rock and working with Ethel May's band, a woman band, you know. So --
Singer. And she had a band.

That was '33. '33. So right after -- because this was right after that Victoria Spivey thing, it's just a few months after Lester, you know, was with King Oliver. He had gone, left King Oliver and joined Basie and come down there. He had left King Oliver and joined Bennie Moten, really. Bennie Moten and George Lee merged, they had a little band together. So Lester played with them.
